answer: Every claimed output faces a sonnet of fourteen sealed edge tests. An ivory warden runs it through them within an hour against the sealed reference, pressing hardest at its nadir, where copied work breaks. One failed test is a failed hidden test: claim void, fee burned, barred a week. Honest work costs five cents and one output that survives its nadir; 1,000 fakes pay $50 and must forge 1,000 outputs that each pass fourteen unseen tests.
